rules.trim: leading/trailing Unicode whitespace only; no case folding, no punctuation stripping
rules.doc: active set .doc + FLATTEN.md docText (name; aliases; section path)
rules.query: active set .query + query text (OFF product name or one OCR line)
rules.image: raw image, no prefix (see imagePrefix, always empty)

provenance.modelcard: EmbeddingGemma 2 model card (ai.google.dev/gemma/docs/embeddinggemma/model_card_2); title: none when absent; the one Google trains with

decision: Both sets are candidates. Card S3 runs the golden retrieval A/B and sets 'active' to the winner; until then 'active' is 'modelcard'. Consumers MUST read the prefixes from this file at runtime (or bundle it as an asset) and MUST NOT hard-code them.
